name: config-file-groups
goal: One table per source config with typed values and cataloged modules under configs

evidence: One accessible table per source config, typed literal presentations, source-preserving value inspection, revision-scoped search, and plural configs ownership for every app config.

Existing groups matrix had one config per category and asserted only raw text. Extend its shared fixture with a second config and short array, and prove separate tables, literal types, filtering, and historical values at all three viewports.
